# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.5

## 2026-10-03

## Fixed

- Forwarding changes are confirmed by reading the actual device mode. Rejected
  or unapplied changes no longer report success, and the Ring Call receiver
  follows the confirmed mode.
- A missing device-side C300X SIP user is reported in media readiness and
  self-test. The guidance points to device provisioning through the BTicino
  app instead of offering a Home Assistant repair for a device-owned identity.

## Security

- Release SBOMs now pass official SPDX 2.3 validation and include the required
  package verification data alongside SHA-256 integrity checks.
- The release workflow verifies both SLSA provenance and SPDX SBOM Sigstore
  bundles against the release workflow, tag ref and commit before publication.

## Maintenance

- Update CodeQL Action to 4.38.0 and the pinned Hassfest action.
- Update validation dependencies to NumPy 2.5.3 and Ruff 0.16.9.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating the integration.
- The release includes a newly built ARMHF C300X device agent `1.9.5`.
  Update the device agent from Home Assistant to receive these fixes.
